The '''Zakuulan Forward Recon''' was a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire military|military]]. In [[3629 BBY]], following the demise of the Eternal Empire, the battalion was led by [[Commander/Legends|Battalion Commander]] [[Tassar (Human)|Tassar]] and settled in [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]] in an attempt to build a new [[Star Fortress]]. The Zakuulan Forward Recon was [[Battle on Rakata Prime|defeated]] by the [[Eternal Alliance]] when their plan was discovered.<ref name="LP" />
